deadline.value: The department gives January 5 for fall admission, but the page gives no year, so no date is recorded.
deadline.quote: For application to the Ph.D. program, the application deadline is January 5 for admission to the program in the fall.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require or recommend the physics GRE Subject test and does not use GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: CWRU Physics neither requires nor recommends that applicants submit GRE scores.

also.quote: This applies to both the general GRE and the physics subject test GRE.

supervisor.value: Admission does not name a supervisor. The Director of Graduate Studies advises students at entry, and a research advisor is found later.
supervisor.quote: Upon entry to graduate school the Master’s and Ph.D. student’s academic advisor will be the department’s Director of Graduate Studies.

also.quote: Eventually, each successful student will acquire a research advisor and dissertation committee.

funding.value: Every Ph.D. offer includes at least the first year of full support (stipend, health insurance and tuition). Renewal depends on progress.
funding.quote: ALL offers of admission to our Ph.D. graduate program in physics will include at least one year of full support

also.quote: CWRU Physics does NOT admit students into our Ph.D. program without also offering financial support for stipend and tuition.
Renewal of a student’s support will be contingent upon evidence of progress toward a degree.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in physics, mathematics or a related field is required. Students with a master's can also enter and take fewer course credits.
entry_route.quote: For admission to the Ph.D. program, a bachelors degree in physics, mathematics, or a related field is required.

also.quote: Students entering the PhD program with a masters degree are only required to take 18 credit hours of course work.

app_fee.value: The department says international applicants pay no application fee. Its FAQ also mentions a $50 fee for lower-GPA applicants, and the School lists $85, so the pages disagree.
app_fee.quote: for international students, there is no application fee

also.quote: Applicants with lower GPAs are welcome to apply but will be charged a $50 application fee by CWRU.
If applicable, pay your non-refundable $85 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants pay no application fee, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: for international students, there is no application fee

gre_general.value: The department does not require or recommend the general GRE and does not use GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: CWRU Physics neither requires nor recommends that applicants submit GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: The FAQ still says 90, but the School's rule for tests from 21 January 2026 is 5.0 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: For TOEFL exams taken on or after January 21, 2026, the minimum score is 5.0

also.quote: The minimum TOEFL score is 90, if internet-based (iBT) and 577 if paper-based

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS of at least 7.0 for admission consideration.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS score for admission consideration is 7.0.

notes: Admission in the fall only. The department's FAQ says applicants need a passing IELTS, TOEFL or PTE score and that the School decides English waiver petitions. The grad-school table lists a PhD date of January 5, 2027, but that table cannot be quoted cell by cell, so the deadline is Not stated.
